frame.bytes: w*h, one byte per cell, value 0-15 = palette index, row-major; optional 2-byte big-endian sequence prefix
frame.hex: h lines of w hex digits, LF-terminated, as a text message; the same information
frame.also_accepted: rgb24 (w*h*3 bytes) at the relay or a shim only; each cell is mapped to the nearest palette entry before fan-out. The sink never quantizes.

same_page.postMessage: {frame}; the page announces {display:"ready", w, h, d} to its opener or parent once mounted

trs80.note: largest field inside a 32 x 16 text screen

green-building.note: Building 54: wide windows with masonry between them

cga40.note: IBM PC CGA 40-column text mode: 320 x 200 on a 4:3 tube, pixel aspect 6:5

gameboy.note: same geometry, named for the original

c64.note: 40 x 25 screen; the full field fits

blinkenlights.note: Haus des Lehrers, Berlin, 2001: 8 floors x 18 windows, one lamp and relay each, on or off
blinkenlights.light_source: 150 W halogen lamp per window on a tripod, relay-switched, windows painted white
blinkenlights.control: relay control cables to one floor; three networked computers: control, playback, telephone interactivity

dc32.note: DEF CON 32 badge, Game Boy field

arcade.note: Bibliotheque nationale de France, Paris, 2002: 20 x 26 windows, 8 grey levels

stereoscope.building: Toronto City Hall, two curved towers
stereoscope.note: per-tower grid not given in the sources consulted; needs w,h per tower and a two-tower mapping

cira-centre.note: Pong 2013, Tetris 2014 (north and south faces); LED grid dimensions not published in the sources consulted

schonherz-matrix.note: annual student display; grid not given in the sources consulted

accepts: MCUF (magic 23542666, channels 1 or 3, any maxval; scaled to 0-15)
interop.note: Blinkenlights-family packets over UDP or as WebSocket binary, at the relay. Display chosen by width x height. UDP lease is 5 s per packet, sender address as holder.
interop.equivalence: pal16 frame == MCUF payload with channels=1, maxval=15, header removed

properties.gap: space between cells as a fraction of a cell
properties.viewing_distance: typical distance to the viewer; sets the minimum useful cell size
properties.schema_note: the descriptive fields follow the Media Architecture Biennale catalogue (facade type, kind of light creation, resolution, luminance, urban situation), so entries can be filled from awards.mediaarchitecture.org
properties.source_url: where the properties were taken from
properties.light_source: what makes a cell bright (lamp + relay, LED, backlit glass)
properties.mono: true: cells are brightness levels 0..levels-1, drawn as a grey ramp; false: cells are palette indices 0-15
properties.native_protocol: the protocol the original installation spoke; the relay accepts it in addition to pal16
properties.w,h: grid in cells, row 0 at top
properties.aspect: cell width / cell height as seen by the viewer (windows are wider than tall)
properties.quantization: a pal16 frame on a display with n levels: index 0 -> 0, otherwise max(1, round(index * (n-1) / 15))

status.relay: not yet hosted; see the spec's experiments section
